dict.string: Sotto records your microphone locally so meeting notes stay on this Mac. Audio is not uploaded by default.
Sotto captures system audio locally so a meeting can be transcribed on this Mac without a bot joining the call. Audio is not uploaded by default.
Sotto uses Screen Recording only to tap what you already hear on this Mac. It does not join meetings as a bot. Audio stays local unless you export it.
Sotto transcribes with Apple on-device speech on this Mac. Meeting audio is not sent to Apple servers.
